name: pgcli-5d5e082e-blind22-ots
instr:
# A Postgres command-line client that gives wrong answers all over, without a test suite

The repository has received 22 separate undocumented edits.

Starting the tool up goes wrong before a statement is ever typed. Pointing it at a preferences file that does not exist yet leaves nothing at that path, not even when the parent folder has to be created first, and a launch that passes a statement to run at startup and then asks the server to answer a ping never gets as far as echoing the statement or printing the reply, and exits unhappily. Connecting by the name of an entry in a service definition file is broken too: a file that opens with several lines of free-form prose before the first bracketed entry ends up with none of its entries found, so the host, user, port and password recorded there are never picked up, while a file whose very first line is already a bracketed entry is reported as though the entry sat behind skipped junk. Asking for a password that was saved in the operating system's credential store hands back an empty string even though the store returns the saved value.

Typing at the interactive input line, text that is plainly unfinished is now taken as done and submitted: a statement with no closing semicolon, a line holding nothing but a comment, an empty line, and a statement whose only semicolon sits inside quotes all count as a finished statement.

The guard that asks you to confirm something destructive is wrong in both directions. Given a list of words
